The cabin combines luxury with everyday practicality. Lux leather-trimmed bucket seats provide comfort for long drives, while the 12.0 Uconnect touchscreen keeps you connected through Apple CarPlay, Google Android Auto, and 4G LTE Wi-Fi connectivity. The harman/kardon audio system delivers premium sound quality, and convenient features like the wireless charging pad and remote start make your daily routine easier.

Safety is built into every drive. The Advanced Safety Group includes adaptive cruise control, automated high beam headlamp control, and a surround view camera system that gives you complete visibility. Lane Keep Assist and Pedestrian Emergency Braking provide additional confidence, while blind spot and cross path detection help you stay aware of your surroundings.

The HEMI 5.7L V8 engine produces power when you need it, delivering 15 city and 21 highway MPG. The Electric Shift-On-Demand transfer case provides on-demand 4WD capability, and the truck's trailer towing group includes reverse steering control and tire pressure monitoring to handle your heaviest loads safely.

Practical features make ownership straightforward. The rear window defroster, rain-sensitive wipers, and dual-zone automatic climate control handle changing weather. Power windows, steering wheel controls, and a power adjustable pedal system personalize your driving position. The 33-gallon fuel tank extends your range between fill-ups.

Visit Southern of Norfolk at 2747 N Military Hwy in Norfolk, VA, across from the airport, to experience this Rebel firsthand.

Safety is engineered into every aspect of this vehicle. Four-wheel independent suspension provides a smooth, controlled ride, while electronic stability control, traction control, and speed-sensing steering work together to maintain stability in various driving conditions. Multiple airbags, including overhead and dual front side impact systems, provide comprehensive occupant protection. Four-wheel disc ABS brakes with brake assist deliver confident stopping power in any situation. Technology seamlessly integrates into daily life through Apple CarPlay and Android Auto compatibility, allowing you to connect your smartphone effortlessly. The navigation system powered by Google Maps keeps you on track, while rain-sensing wipers and auto high-beam headlights adapt to changing conditions. An exterior parking camera provides clear rear visibility, and the panoramic vista roof floods the cabin with natural light. The Ford Connectivity Package and Ford Security Package are included, providing comprehensive peace of mind for your investment. With 15 city MPG and 22 highway MPG, this full-size SUV balances performance with reasonable fuel efficiency for its class. This Tremor stands ready to deliver the capability, comfort, and technology you expect from a premium full-size SUV. Come experience it firsthand and discover why the Expedition Tremor is the intelligent choice for your next vehicle.

2023 GMC Yukon Denali 4WD 420HP 6.2L V8, Denali Reserve Package, panoramic moonroof, Super Cruise, rear entertainment, and factory warranty remaining this is a fully loaded, top-tier luxury SUV built for buyers in Florida who refuse to settle for anything less than the best.
Powered by the legendary 6.2L V8 delivering 420 horsepower, paired with advanced 4WD and the Premium Capability Package with Active Response 4WD, this Yukon delivers effortless acceleration, confident towing, and composed control in any driving condition. Magnetic Ride Control and Air Ride Adaptive Suspension transform every drive into a smooth, commanding experience whether you re navigating Tampa Bay traffic or heading out on long-distance travel.
This Denali is not just well-equipped it is max-spec d. The Denali Reserve Package, Advanced Technology Package, and Max Trailering Package combine to create one of the most complete Yukons available on the market. Super Cruise hands-free driving technology sets it apart immediately, offering a level of convenience and innovation most vehicles in this class simply do not have.
Inside, it delivers true full-size luxury. Quad seating with second-row captain s chairs provides first-class comfort for passengers, while the power-folding third row ensures flexibility for cargo and family needs. Heated and ventilated front seats, heated second row seating, a heated steering wheel, and premium perforated leather throughout create a refined, high-end environment designed for both daily driving and long road trips.
The panoramic dual-pane sunroof floods the cabin with natural light, while the rear seat media system keeps passengers engaged and comfortable making this Yukon ideal for families who expect both luxury and functionality. The Bose 14-speaker surround system, wireless charging, Apple CarPlay, Android Auto, and integrated navigation complete a fully modern, connected driving experience.
Technology and safety are layered throughout, including HD Surround Vision, head-up display, enhanced automatic emergency braking, lane keep assist, blind zone alert, rear pedestrian alert, reverse automatic braking, and GMC s Safety Alert Seat all working together to deliver confidence and awareness from every angle.
On the exterior, the 22-inch multi-spoke gloss black wheels and power-retractable assist steps give it a strong, premium stance that matches its capability. Every detail signals that this is not just another Yukon it is a flagship-level Denali built to stand above everything else in its class.
The reality is simple finding a Yukon Denali with Reserve Package, Super Cruise, rear entertainment, 4WD, and remaining factory warranty is extremely rare, especially in this condition and configuration.
If you re searching anywhere in Florida for a fully loaded luxury SUV that checks every box performance, technology, space, and status this is the Yukon that stands above the rest.

The 2025 Subaru Outback Wilderness in Ice Silver Metallic is a rugged yet refined SUV that is built for adventure while providing the comfort, technology, and practicality needed for everyday driving. Finished in the striking Ice Silver Metallic exterior color, this Outback Wilderness combines bold styling with off-road capability, making it an excellent choice for drivers who enjoy exploring beyond the pavement without sacrificing comfort or convenience.

Powered by a responsive turbocharged SUBARU BOXER® engine paired with a smooth Lineartronic® CVT, the 2025 Outback Wilderness delivers strong performance and confident acceleration. Subaru's legendary Symmetrical All-Wheel Drive system comes standard, providing outstanding traction and stability in rain, snow, mud, gravel, and other challenging road conditions. With increased ground clearance and an off-road-tuned suspension, the Wilderness trim is designed to confidently tackle rough terrain while maintaining a smooth and comfortable ride on the highway.

The exterior features exclusive Wilderness styling, including rugged body cladding, unique alloy wheels wrapped in all-terrain tires, LED headlights, roof rails with increased load capacity, and bold copper-colored accents that set it apart from other Outback models. The Ice Silver Metallic finish complements the rugged design while adding a clean and sophisticated appearance.

Inside, the spacious cabin is thoughtfully designed to provide comfort and durability. The Outback Wilderness offers seating for up to five passengers with water-resistant StarTex® upholstery, supportive seats, and high-quality materials throughout the interior. The roomy cabin provides generous headroom and legroom, while the versatile cargo area offers plenty of space for camping gear, luggage, groceries, sports equipment, and other outdoor essentials. Folding rear seats provide even more flexibility when transporting larger items.

Technology is a major highlight of the 2025 Subaru Outback Wilderness. It comes equipped with a large touchscreen infotainment system, Apple CarPlay, Android Auto, Bluetooth connectivity, multiple USB ports, navigation capability, wireless smartphone integration, and a premium audio system. These features help keep drivers and passengers connected, entertained, and informed on every adventure.

Convenience features such as keyless entry, push-button start, dual-zone automatic climate control, heated front seats, a power-adjustable driver's seat, and a power rear liftgate make daily driving and long trips more comfortable and enjoyable.

Safety remains one of Subaru's greatest strengths. The Outback Wilderness comes equipped with EyeSight® Driver Assist Technology, including adaptive cruise control, pre-collision braking, lane centering assist, lane departure warning, blind spot monitoring, rear cross-traffic alert, automatic emergency steering, and a rearview camera. These advanced safety features help enhance driver awareness and provide added peace of mind wherever the road leads.

The 2025 Subaru Outback Wilderness in Ice Silver Metallic is an outstanding choice for drivers seeking a vehicle that combines off-road capability, premium comfort, advanced technology, and exceptional safety. With its rugged design, spacious interior, dependable all-wheel drive, and legendary Subaru reliability, this Outback Wilderness is ready for daily commutes, family road trips, and unforgettable outdoor adventures alike.

description:
The certified 2022 Honda Accord Sport in Modern Steel Metallic is a sleek and sporty midsize sedan that offers an outstanding combination of performance, efficiency, comfort, and advanced technology. Finished in the sophisticated Modern Steel Metallic exterior color, this Accord Sport features a bold and modern design that gives it a confident presence on the road. Its athletic stance, sculpted body lines, and distinctive styling elements make it an attractive choice for drivers who want both practicality and style.

Powered by a responsive turbocharged 1.5-liter 4-cylinder engine paired with a smooth continuously variable transmission (CVT), the 2022 Accord Sport delivers excellent fuel efficiency and confident performance. Whether you're commuting through city traffic, traveling on the highway, or taking a weekend road trip, the Accord provides smooth acceleration, responsive handling, and a comfortable ride that makes every drive enjoyable.

The exterior design is enhanced by sporty features such as stylish alloy wheels, LED headlights and taillights, a bold front grille, and chrome exhaust finishers. The Modern Steel Metallic paint complements the Accords sophisticated design, giving it a refined appearance that remains timeless and professional.

Inside, the Accord Sport offers a spacious and well-designed cabin with seating for up to five passengers. Premium materials, supportive sport-inspired seats, and a driver-focused layout create a comfortable and inviting environment. The generous rear-seat space provides excellent comfort for passengers, while the large trunk offers plenty of room for luggage, groceries, and other everyday cargo.

Technology is one of the highlights of the 2022 Honda Accord Sport. It comes equipped with a touchscreen infotainment system, Apple CarPlay, Android Auto, Bluetooth connectivity, USB ports, steering wheel-mounted controls, and a customizable digital driver information display. These features help keep drivers connected, entertained, and informed throughout every journey.

Convenience features such as push-button start, remote entry, dual-zone automatic climate control, and multiple charging options add to the overall comfort and ease of ownership. Every detail is designed to make daily driving more enjoyable and convenient.

Safety is a major strength of the Accord Sport. It comes equipped with Honda Sensing® driver-assistance technologies, including adaptive cruise control, lane keeping assist, collision mitigation braking, road departure mitigation, traffic sign recognition, automatic high-beam headlights, and a multi-angle rearview camera. These advanced systems help improve driver awareness and provide added confidence behind the wheel.

The 2022 Honda Accord Sport in Modern Steel Metallic is an excellent choice for drivers seeking a stylish, efficient, and dependable sedan. With its sporty design, spacious interior, advanced technology, impressive safety features, and Hondas reputation for long-term reliability, this Accord Sport delivers exceptional value and a rewarding driving experience for years to come.

The M52 family was recognized on Ward's 10 Best Engines list during its production run and remains a well-understood, well-supported platform among BMW enthusiasts.The E36 introduced a multi-link rear suspension that was a real step forward for the 3 Series, and paired with rear-wheel drive and balanced weight distribution, it is a big part of why the chassis still feels so connected to drive. Inside, the gray leather interior is paired with a Harman Kardon premium audio system, a desirable factory upgrade over the standard stereo. The 2024 Accord LX is built around a lively 1.5L turbocharged I 4 and a smooth continuously variable transmission that together prioritize both fuel economy and composed acceleration. Whether commutes or weekend drives, the powertrain provides confident passing power while helping keep trips economical.

Safety tech is a standout in this LX, beginning with systems designed to anticipate and respond to hazards. Forward collision mitigation readies the vehicle and occupants when it senses a potential front-end impact, aiming to reduce or avoid collisions. Complementing that is front pedestrian impact prevention, which scans and tracks people ahead and intervenes if a collision becomes likely a reassurance for busy streets and neighborhood driving. Lane departure prevention actively helps keep the Accord centered between the lines, stepping in with subtle corrections if the car starts to drift. For highway comfort, the hands-on steering assist and lane centering features act like a steady co pilot, maintaining spacing and lane position to cut fatigue on longer trips.

Adaptive cruise control with traffic stop go extends convenience through congested conditions by matching speeds to the vehicle ahead, bringing the car to a stop when traffic halts and resuming smoothly when it moves again. Brake assist boosts your stopping response in emergencies by applying maximum braking force when rapid pedal travel indicates a panic stop.

Everyday usability is enhanced with practical tech: smart device mirroring integrates smartphones with the infotainment screen so navigation, calls, and media are accessible without hunting for your phone; a rear camera provides a clearer view when reversing to help avoid obstacles; and an onboard mobile hotspot keeps passengers connected on the go.

Inside, the Accord LX focuses on driver-friendly controls and a comfortable cabin layout so daily routines and longer trips feel more relaxed. Steering-wheel mounted cruise controls make speed adjustments effortless, reducing fatigue and helping maintain consistent efficiency.

In short, the 2024 Honda Accord LX CVT is a thoughtfully equipped midsize sedan that emphasizes occupant protection, seamless connectivity, and composed performance. It s a sensible choice for buyers who want modern safety systems, practical tech, and an efficient turbocharged powertrain in a comfortable, well-engineered package.
